description: TENG with surface charge density dynamics: charge decay (leakage), dielectric loss, frequency-dependent charge transfer, and multi-layer dielectric stack

unit.name: PTFE-Al contact-separation TENG — surface charge dynamics
unit.source: Niu, S. & Wang, Z.L. (2015) Nano Energy 14, 161-192; Wang, Z.L. (2013) ACS Nano; Zi, Y. et al. (2015) ACS Nano

sigma0.note: Peak surface charge density (PTFE-Al: 20-100 uC/m^2 from charged PTFE)

tau_decay_s.note: Surface charge decay time constant (leakage, ~100s-hours for PTFE)
